title: Every R&D agent behind the chat: the twin, the research campaign on Claude, the store; a real-use pass on Telco; settings, effort and fast mode in the app (agents plan steps 2-6)
request: The owner's goal (restated by the stop hook): every agentic system designed in R&D works behind DCLab Code's chat, with Claude Code's and Codex's capabilities, in sync with R&D on GitHub.
spec: the agents plan, the rest of step 2 (twin, campaign), step 3 (store and students), step 5 (the lock at R&D on GitHub), step 6 (a real-use pass, then C7 settings and C8 effort/fast)
plan: the lock at the R&D commit on GitHub
the twin on a scratch workspace with the owner's switch on, capped
the campaign on the product's Claude, tested on one tiny call before a run
the store's agents as read-only commands from the chat
a real-use pass on Telco churn, as a retention manager would ask
C7 a settings sheet and C8 effort and fast mode, page-tested

decisions.decision: The campaign calls Claude through litellm's own Anthropic path, not an OpenAI-compatible shim
decisions.why: the Claude API guide says to call Claude through Anthropic's own client; litellm already speaks it natively

decisions.decision: The campaign uses Claude Sonnet 5 when the product's model refuses forced tool use
decisions.why: NOOA's typed answers arrive as a forced tool call; Sonnet 5 answers them at Sonnet 5.5's price

decisions.decision: The twin's switch was turned on only in a scratch copy of the workspace
decisions.why: the switch is the owner's; the chat reaches the twin, the owner decides whether it runs

decisions.decision: Amounts heard but not added stay the person's to add; the tools now say so
decisions.why: 34.4 keeps the person's choice; adding them after the build reads the holdout a second time, which the agent then declined

decisions.decision: The settings sheet saves only from the app's own page
decisions.why: the caps limit spending: neither a script nor the agent should raise them

change: R&D: agentic/campaign_model.py (new), agents.py, routers/runs.py, routers/core.py, schemas.py, __main__.py, models/prices.py (claude-sonnet-5), intern/tools.py (get_results and decision_what_if say the heard decision), tests. dclab-code: config.js (EFFORTS, FAST_MODELS, NO_THINKING_OFF, THINKING), engine.js (effort, fast, thinking off on 5.5), app.js (sameOrigin, settings routes, project removal and re-add, unlisted sessions), web (Effort, Fast, the Settings sheet), docs/PARITY_PLAN.md, sync lock at dcde6e89, tests.

findings.defect: the research campaign could only call OpenAI, which the owner blocks
findings.scenario: POST /api/runs: 409 'runs on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint only'
findings.cause: NOOA's client was built as openai/<model> with OPENAI_BASE_URL
findings.fix: campaign_model picks the product's Claude (litellm's anthropic/<model>, the standard tier's key, drop_params) when DCLAB_LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic, else the OpenAI path, refused when blocked
findings.test: R&D tests/test_agentic.py (the provider choice; the route test needs pandas and NOOA together, which no environment has)

findings.defect: the campaign's first Claude run failed on its first call
findings.scenario: BadRequestError: tool_choice type tool and any are not supported for this model
findings.cause: NOOA's typed answers reach Anthropic as a forced tool call, which Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 refuse
findings.fix: those models are replaced by claude-sonnet-5 (same price, priced in prices.py); DCLAB_CAMPAIGN_MODEL overrides

findings.defect: the Telco answer left out the leavers caught at the person's 20% call budget
findings.scenario: s_0cc0fbb63ac1: 'DCLab did not report how many leavers it catches at 20%'
findings.cause: the person's costs stayed a suggestion (34.4: heard, not added) and get_results said nothing about the decision
findings.fix: get_results adds the decision: status, stated, heard, why no what-if can be asked, and a note when amounts were heard but not added; decision_what_if's view includes heard
findings.test: R&D tests/test_decisions_product.py; rerun s_ce3c89331d39: about 186 of 374 leavers at 20%, the second holdout read declined

findings.defect: thinking 'off' made every turn fail on the two main models
findings.scenario: config thinking off with Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5: thinking {type: disabled} is a 400
findings.cause: the option predates models that refuse disabled thinking
findings.fix: on those models off runs adaptive thinking with nothing shown; Haiku keeps disabled
findings.test: dclab-code server test (the old test asserted the bug)

findings.cause: the page's policy form-action 'none' blocks every form submission
findings.fix: Save is a button with its own handler; Enter in a field saves

findings.defect: the Fast toggle never appeared before a session
findings.scenario: choosing Opus 5.5 in a new session's model menu
findings.cause: the menu's change handler redrew only the status line
findings.fix: it shows or hides Fast with the model

findings.defect: the campaign's Claude path skipped the live-model guard
findings.scenario: tests/test_provider_block.py run directly: ProviderBlocked not raised; importing litellm loads the owner's .env, so a test could reach Claude on the real key
findings.cause: litellm's HTTP client never passes through the gateway's client, where the guard sits
findings.fix: client_args asks live_guard.check; the block test blanks the provider
findings.test: R&D test_provider_block, test_agentic (no real client inside a test)

findings.defect: any claude-* name was accepted, and an unpriced one was never counted by the euro caps
findings.scenario: POST /api/runs {model: claude-opus-4-7, max_experiments: 50}: up to 105 calls on the owner's key, the caps blind
findings.cause: the schema allowed claude-*; prices.py prices three Claude models
findings.fix: an unpriced Claude is replaced by the priced default, client_args and the route refuse an unpriced one, DCLAB_CAMPAIGN_MODEL included

findings.defect: a run resumed from the command line could move to another provider
findings.scenario: resume an OpenAI run while the server runs on Claude: requests as anthropic/gpt-5.6-terra, or the other way, prompts to OpenAI
findings.cause: only the route checked the provider
findings.fix: AuditedClient passes the run's own provider to client_args, which refuses a change; the command line refuses it first

findings.defect: removing a project in Settings removed its sessions' guards
findings.scenario: after a restart nothing is live: remove R&D, reopen an old R&D session, 'make benchmark SPLIT=test' runs without its card
findings.cause: the check counted only live sessions; a session's guards come from its project's entry (followRd)
findings.fix: a project stays while any session that is not archived uses it; a session whose project is gone does no work; R&D added again gets followRd

measurements.name: research campaign on Claude, live
measurements.result: 5 model calls, 43,750 input and 13,819 output tokens on Claude Sonnet 5, one leakage-safe experiment, about EUR 0.23

measurements.name: Telco real use through the chat
measurements.gate: the person's question answered with DCLab's numbers
measurements.result: holdout ROC-AUC 0.84 (0.82 to 0.86); after the fix about 186 of 374 leavers caught at 20%, net about EUR 54,400 if each caught leaver is saved; $0.34

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 105 of 105 (Chromium page tests included); R&D test_agentic 14 (2 skipped: pandas and NOOA are never in one environment), test_provider_block, test_decisions_product, test_intern, the harness suite

outcome: Every R&D agent is reached from the chat or stays the owner's for a stated reason; the campaign no longer needs OpenAI; the app has a settings sheet, effort and fast mode.
lessons: Test a new provider path with one tiny real call before a run: the forced-tool refusal showed in two seconds.
A guard that lives in one client does not cover a library with its own HTTP client: ask it where that client is built.
Use the product like its user would: the missing business number showed only when the question was a manager's.
risks: the campaign route test never runs (no environment holds both NOOA and pandas)
store status prints 840 KB, too long for a chat
the build card shows the gates passed, not the problem card
